core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ihtisham is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Modesty, decorum, dignified restraint”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ihtisham corresponds to the Arabic form احتشام (Arabic root ح ش م (ḥ-sh-m); اِحْتِشَام (Iḥtishām)). Its core sense is modesty, decorum, dignified restraint. Ihtisham is Arabic اِحْتِشَام (Iḥtishām) 'modesty, decorum, dignified restraint', from the root ح ش م (ḥ-sh-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave أيثم (a different word) and glossed the name 'Respect, Reverence, Dedication'; the correct form is اِحْتِشَام.
